_comment: The pending expectation, read from a REAL run — a dry run cannot see these, because the flag-gated specs skip at runtime (this.skip() in the body). `case_count` is asserted so a spec that STOPS skipping (and starts running, or fails) shows up as a change rather than a quieter gate, and so does one that starts skipping for a new reason.
